create_ContiguousKVCache: create a ContiguousKVCache with n_kv_heads, head_dim, max_seq_len, and dtype for pre-allocated KV buffer
test_ContiguousKVCache_update_and_fetch: test ContiguousKVCache.update_and_fetch to append K/V tensors and return all valid K/V up to current offset
